name: Body
vision_statement: What the AI says about a person's account is the account as it is now.
opportunities: The Quest account is the AI's own consistent state, which opens questions beyond the parent solution: how the AI states what it can reach (inside the host, outside it, in the world now, or not reachable) and is held to that claim, how heavy work is handed to a deep runner within a fixed turn and cost bound and its result checked, how a file change is kept bounded to one folder and reversible, how one named change on an outside tool server is made only when an allowlist permits it, and who a new goal belongs to and whether an AI representative can take it over.
solution_coherence: Body keeps what the AI says about a person's account true to the account and to what it changed in it. It changes the quest as the person asks through Quest change executor and writes files inside one folder through Bounded reversible file writer. It reads from the sources the person's work lives in through Multi-source evidence retriever, and hands a new goal to the right owner through Goal assignee and doability judge. It claims only the reach that World grants. Heavy work is the job of Bounded autonomous work runner. One named change on an outside tool server is the job of Allowlisted operation writer.
